content_metadata.description: Analysis of the Mortal Kombat gameplay trailer featuring Peacemaker, focusing on scenes, characters, and narrative progression.

qAndA.question: What is the name of Peacemaker's eagle?

qAndA.answer: He briefly becomes translucent, seemingly phasing through attacks.
qAndA.question: What unique ability does Peacemaker display in his fight against Kung Lao?
What weapon does Mileena use during her fight with Peacemaker and Sonya Blade?

qAndA.answer: She uses a surgical tool to remove his eye and then crushes his skull.
qAndA.question: How does Sonya Blade perform a fatality on Noob Saibot?

qAndA.answer: The fatalities shift the mood from exciting to darkly humorous due to their graphic nature and Peacemaker's nonchalant attitude afterwards.
qAndA.question: How is the mood of the trailer affected by the use of fatalities?

Eat peace, Motherfuckers!

Peacemaker comes to MK1 Early Access February 28, Full Release March 6. Janet Cage joins the Kameo roster later in March.

Get the Premium Edition or add the Kombat Pack to your Standard Edition to play as Peacemaker: https://www.mortalkombat.com/purchase
